transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I guess I'm here because... well, I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or right when I get home. I really hate doing it, but... I don't know, it's just started feeling like it's the only way I can actually calm down.
Before you make yourself vomit, do you ever eat an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah, I do. Um... when it happens, I can go through a lot. Like, I'll eat a full bag of chips, some pastries from the corner store, whatever leftovers are around, and a bunch of sweet drinks just... all in one sitting. I don't even really notice how much is actually gone until after.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount and then making yourself vomit happen?

Honestly, it's a lot. For months now, um... I'd say most weeks have at least a couple of episodes. Usually more, actually. I'll end up eating way more than I ever meant to, and then I just feel like I have to try and undo it. Throwing up is the main way, but sometimes I'll just not eat anything at all the next day, or I'll try to exercise it all off. But yeah, it's happening multiple times a week at this point.
How much do your weight or body shape affect how you feel about yourself?

Honestly, a lot. It's... it pretty much dictates everything. Like, I can be doing really good at the shop, getting all the work done, and I'll still feel like a total failure if I catch my reflection in the glass and my stomach or my hips look big to me. It just completely takes over how I feel about myself.
